description: This PHP source file defines a controller class for managing voucher totals in the OpenCart admin extension. It contains methods for rendering the voucher total configuration page and saving its settings, including permission checks and configuration updates.

classes.name: Voucher
classes.description: Controller class for managing the total voucher settings in the admin panel of OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles rendering the voucher total configuration page in the admin panel, setting up breadcrumbs, page title, and loading necessary templates.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes AJAX requests to save voucher total configuration settings, performing permission checks, updating settings, and returning JSON responses.
